summary: The LLM landscape today is dominated by a handful of frontier families — OpenAI's GPT series, Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini, and Meta's open-weight Llama — supplemented by fast-rising open models from DeepSeek, Mistral, and Alibaba's Qwen. Real-world developer adoption is driven as much by enterprise aggregator reach (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx) as by direct API usage. Because much of the live research data references unreleased or speculative version numbers (e.g., GPT-6, Gemini 3.1), this list is restricted to models that are confirmably publicly available today.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Highest overall API call volume and ChatGPT-driven developer adoption; broadly available directly and through Azure OpenAI, giving it the deepest enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose multimodal applications and chat assistants at scale

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Research confirms Sonnet 4.6 shipped matching Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing; heavily used for coding and available via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and direct API.
models.best_for: Coding, agentic workflows, and enterprise document processing

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, low-cost workhorse with very large context; natively distributed through Google Vertex AI, giving massive enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: High-throughput, cost-sensitive tasks with long-context needs

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Google's flagship reasoning model, widely adopted via Vertex AI and the Gemini API for complex multimodal and long-context tasks.
models.best_for: Complex reasoning and large-document multimodal analysis

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: Most-downloaded open-weight model family on HuggingFace and widely hosted across AWS Bedrock, Azure, Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx, giving it enormous self-host and aggregator reach.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: Open reasoning model with rapid HuggingFace adoption and major cost advantages; increasingly offered through third-party and aggregator inference platforms.

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Research notes DeepSeek delivers roughly 90% of frontier performance at a fraction of the cost; its MoE V3 base is widely downloaded and hosted by inference providers.
models.best_for: High-volume general-purpose generation at low cost

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic's fast, low-cost tier widely adopted for high-volume agentic and classification tasks; available via AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Leading European enterprise model available through Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Vertex AI, with strong adoption in EU-sovereignty-focused deployments.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Top-performing open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads and strong international (especially APAC) developer adoption.
models.best_for: Open-weight deployments requiring strong multilingual and reasoning performance
